snippet.title: Hell Let Loose: Vietnam - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description: Check out the launch trailer for Hell Let Loose: Vietnam, the 50v50 PvP multiplayer tactical first-person shooter. It launches on August 13 for PC (Steam and Epic Games Store), PS5, and Xbox Series X|S. Wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3079210/Hell_Let_Loose_Vietnam/
